args.script:
total=0
for f in /root/example_files/*.txt; do
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    # Check if line contains only digits (optionally with a leading minus sign)
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]]; then
      total=$((total + line))
    fi
  done < "$f"
done
echo "Total sum: $total"
